issue.title: [Glitch] auto-compiler re-enables every compilation
issue.body: Whenever you compile your PDF without the auto-compiler on, it turns itself back on again. This means you then have to re-disable it every single time you want to compile.

expected.cause: apps/web/src/components/editor/EditorLayout.tsx calls setAutoCompileEnabled(true) in both successful-build handlers, so every successful compile switches auto-compile back on.
